destination.title: Stabilization and de Sitter construction
destination.question: Which compactification ingredients can stabilize the relevant fields and produce de Sitter critical points or metastable minima?
destination.summary: Compare construction mechanisms while keeping their systems, retained fields and claimed degree of control distinct.

systems: Supergravity uplift models with prospective compactification applications
targets: Uplift or deformation from AdS and Minkowski
regimes: Classical, perturbatively corrected and nonperturbative models
assumptions: Each construction retains its own field content and source assumptions
conventions: Critical point, stable retained sector and fully metastable vacuum remain different claims
includes: Anti-D3, F-term, D-term, instanton, higher-curvature and Casimir mechanisms
excludes: Automatic certification of string consistency or parametric control

sources.title: On Issues in Swiss Cheese Compactifications

evidence.text: Can corrected Swiss-cheese compactifications support a nonsupersymmetric de Sitter minimum without anti-D3 uplift and axionic slow-roll inflation? Separately, how can extremal black-hole charges and fake superpotentials be obtained from prescribed attractor moduli?

sources.title: Warped de Sitter compactifications

evidence.text: Under what metric and matter-field conditions do warped higher-dimensional solutions contain de Sitter spacetime, and can internal flux stabilize the compact-space scale in a lower-dimensional cosmological model?

sources.title: Constructing stable de Sitter in M-theory from higher curvature corrections

evidence.text: Can higher-curvature corrections and G7 flux lift the sole volume flat direction of geometric, non-supersymmetric Minkowski compactifications to produce metastable de Sitter vacua at large volume?

sources.title: Large Volume Scenario from Schoen Manifold with de Sitter under Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can self-mirror Schoen compactifications support large-volume de Sitter vacua through nonperturbative effects when the Euler-characteristic-dependent correction vanishes, while satisfying the quoted asymptotic swampland bound?

sources.title: Membrane instantons and de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Can membrane-instanton corrections to the universal hypermultiplet geometry, combined with type IIA background flux, stabilize the hypermultiplet moduli in a metastable de Sitter vacuum?

sources.title: On de Sitter vacua in type IIA orientifold compactifications

evidence.text: Can perturbative and membrane-instanton corrections inherited from the N=2 universal hypermultiplet provide an intrinsic uplift from AdS to metastable de Sitter after orientifolding a type IIA compactification on a rigid Calabi–Yau threefold?

sources.title: De-Sitter vacua via consistent D-terms

evidence.text: Can gauge-consistent D-terms produce locally stable de-Sitter or Minkowski vacua with spontaneously broken N=1 supersymmetry and no residual scalar flat directions, with possible applications to flux compactifications?

sources.title: Issues in type IIA uplifting

evidence.text: Can a positive F-term sector uplift stabilized AdS vacua of a simplified massive type IIA flux compactification to metastable de Sitter vacua with positive cosmological constant?

sources.title: On Issues in Swiss Cheese Compactifications

evidence.text: Analyze the axion-sector gradient and covariant Hessian with its field-space metric, including connection terms. Diagonalize kinetic and mass terms at weak coupling to identify a light axionic combination, and estimate e-foldings along the saddle-to-minimum trajectory.

sources.title: Warped de Sitter compactifications

evidence.text: Reduce the D-dimensional action over Z and perform a Weyl transformation to the (n+1)-dimensional Einstein frame. Derive an A–ψ potential and kinetic terms, including kinetic mixing, then examine the ψ potential with A held fixed.

sources.title: Constructing stable de Sitter in M-theory from higher curvature corrections

evidence.text: Move critical points to S=T=U=i using noncompact SL(2,R)^3 transformations and unrestricted flux reparametrization. Solve quadratic algebraic field equations; a Maldacena–Nuñez-type identity V=λI∂IV+V0 with V0 nonpositive identifies the gauge-flux-free Minkowski locus.

sources.title: Large Volume Scenario from Schoen Manifold with de Sitter under Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Inserts the proposed volume forms into the N=1 F-term potential, computes inverse Kähler metrics, expands in inverse volume with instanton exponentials, and solves stationarity equations analytically and through plotted parameter examples.

sources.title: Membrane instantons and de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Expand e^h in instanton exponentials and loop powers, solving successive inhomogeneous Laplace equations. One-instanton solutions use separation of variables and spherical Bessel functions; numerical methods analyze the truncated scalar potential.

sources.title: On de Sitter vacua in type IIA orientifold compactifications

evidence.text: Truncates the hypermultiplet metric under the orientifold, introduces corrected complex coordinates to express it as Kähler, and compares the N=1 F-term potential with the projected N=2 gauged potential.

sources.title: LVS de Sitter vacua are probably in the swampland

evidence.text: Do corrections omitted from the standard LARGE-volume effective potential remain small enough to establish the existence, vacuum energy and stability of candidate de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: Compactifying de Sitter space naturally selects a small cosmological constant

evidence.text: Does compactifying a positive-cosmological-constant higher-dimensional theory on multiple dynamical flux-supported spheres produce a distribution of lower-dimensional de Sitter vacua that accumulates at zero cosmological constant?

sources.title: Lifetime of Stringy de Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: Can fluxless M-theory stabilization by a racetrack and hidden meson yield a de Sitter vacuum with a sufficiently broad geometric decompactification barrier?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization, large-volume dS minimum without D3-bar branes, (non-)supersymmetric black hole attractors and two-parameter Swiss cheese Calabi-Yau's

evidence.text: Can flux stabilization admit finitely separated vacua for identical fluxes, and can nonperturbative corrections produce a large-volume nonsupersymmetric de Sitter minimum without an anti-D3 uplift?

sources.title: de Sitter string vacua from perturbative Kahler corrections and consistent D-terms

evidence.text: Can perturbative Kähler stabilization of the volume modulus be combined with a gauge-consistent D-term uplift to obtain metastable de Sitter vacua in type IIB flux compactifications?

sources.title: De Sitter vacua in string theory

evidence.text: Can warped type IIB flux compactifications stabilize all moduli, then admit controlled supersymmetry breaking that produces metastable de Sitter vacua? Can their lifetimes exceed cosmological times while remaining below the de Sitter recurrence time?

sources.title: Beginners lectures on flux compactifications and related Swampland topics

evidence.text: How do flux compactifications stabilize moduli and determine the sign and size of vacuum energy? Can they yield parametrically controlled metastable de Sitter or AdS vacua with decoupled massive towers?

sources.title: Membrane and fivebrane instantons and 0 geometry

evidence.text: How do wrapped membrane and NS fivebrane instantons correct the universal hypermultiplet geometry in type IIA compactifications, and can membrane corrections contribute to moduli stabilization and metastable de Sitter vacua after flux gauging?

sources.title: A dS obstruction and its phenomenological consequences

evidence.text: Can abelian flux stabilize a positive runaway potential into controlled lower-dimensional de Sitter solutions, and what restrictions follow if such solutions are forbidden in quantum gravity?

sources.title: The Flux-Scaling Scenario: De Sitter Uplift and Axion Inflation

evidence.text: Can flux-scaling AdS constructions be extended to stable Minkowski or metastable de Sitter vacua using positive brane-tension or flux-induced D-term contributions, and can the resulting models support axion monodromy inflation with the required scale hierarchy?

sources.title: Self-mirror Large Volume Scenario with de Sitter

evidence.text: Can self-mirror compactification reconcile large volume with a T-dual/mirror description and generate de Sitter vacua through nonperturbative Kähler-modulus contributions?

sources.title: WEAKLY-coupled IIA Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Can restricted-flux type-IIA Calabi–Yau compactifications reproduce LARGE-volume phenomenology through exponentially weak coupling, controlled moduli stabilization and a tunable de Sitter uplift?

sources.title: On (A)dS solutions from Scherk-Schwarz orbifolds

evidence.text: Can curvature, quantized fluxes and supersymmetry-breaking one-loop Casimir energy produce controlled, metastable de Sitter vacua in type II Scherk-Schwarz compactifications? What distinguishes the corresponding anti-de Sitter solutions?

sources.title: An M-theory dS maximum from Casimir energies on Riemann-flat manifolds

evidence.text: Can calculable Casimir energy and quantized flux on smooth, nonsupersymmetric Riemann-flat manifolds support controlled de Sitter critical points without singular sources?

sources.title: Complete classification of Minkowski vacua in generalised flux models

evidence.text: Which generalized-flux models in the isotropic type II orientifold class admit nonsupersymmetric Minkowski extrema with all retained moduli stabilized, and can stable extrema be continuously deformed to de Sitter?

sources.title: Rigid nongeometric orientifolds and the swampland

evidence.text: Can different consistent flux choices evade existing de Sitter restrictions or produce new ones when all displayed axion dependence is retained? Appendix B identifies this application but supplies no resulting inequality or controlled vacuum within this window.

sources.title: On the limitations of non-geometric fluxes to realize dS vacua

evidence.text: Which conditions on moduli and generalized fluxes exclude de Sitter extrema in type IIA compactifications, and how much further can these exclusions be classified under an F-term alignment Ansatz?

sources.title: Systematic exploration of the non-geometric flux landscape

evidence.text: Can axionic flux polynomials enable systematic analytic exclusion of fully stabilized Minkowski and de Sitter vacua in an isotropic non-geometric flux model, and which configurations remain unresolved?

sources.title: Inflationary Constraints on Type IIA String Theory

evidence.text: Appendix A supplies a four-dimensional N=1 supergravity account: Kähler geometry separates the universal kinetic directions, while the superpotential scalings reproduce the potential after cancellation of an additional candidate term.

sources.title: On the Cosmology of Type IIA Compactifications on SU(3)-structure Manifolds

evidence.text: For SU(2)×SU(2), construct the scalar potential from the explicit Kähler potential and superpotential, numerically minimize ε, and inspect scalar mass eigenvalues and η near the resulting extrema.

sources.title: Searching for slow-roll moduli inflation in massive type IIA supergravity with metric fluxes

evidence.text: Solve flux Bianchi identities, use potential-preserving field redefinitions to reach configurations covered by bounds, and minimize ε numerically over moduli and fluxes. Base–fiber twisted-torus constructions provide explicit consistency and NSNS quantization tests for selected examples.

sources.title: Metastable de Sitter vacua in N=2 to N=1 truncated supergravity

evidence.text: For one hypermultiplet, use the local Przanowski–Tod parametrization of four-dimensional quaternionic spaces with an isometry. Geometry is encoded by h(r,u,v), satisfying h_uu+h_vv+(e^h)_rr=0, with f=2−r h_r. Connections, curvatures and truncation conditions are obtained using vielbeins and torsion-free equations.

sources.title: On the distribution of stable de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: The authors sample random supersymmetry-breaking parameters and compute scalar mass spectra. They complement this with two-dimensional slices fixing four parameters at a previously known isotropically stable dS point, comparing potential and minimum-mass contours. The initial scan uses 10^7 points; the small dS tail receives ten times that sample.

sources.title: Fully stable dS vacua from generalised fluxes

evidence.text: Local parameter-space analysis holds the other SUSY-breaking coordinates fixed and plots normalised-energy and minimum-mass contours in the (AS,BS) plane. The overlap of positive-energy and positive-minimum-mass regions identifies stable dS slices.

sources.title: Moduli Stabilization with Non‐Geometric Fluxes — Comments on Tadpole Contributions and de‐Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: Can H,F,Q,R,F3 compactifications yield a consistent, controlled and fully stable de Sitter vacuum, and can the proposed tadpole-sign restriction be derived from first principles?

sources.title: Weakly Coupled de Sitter Vacua with Fluxes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can classical type IIA fluxes and localized sources stabilize the universal volume and inverse string coupling in a parametrically controlled de Sitter regime? The displayed potential supplies the common setting for the explicit no-go arguments.

sources.title: de Sitter Extrema and the Swampland

evidence.text: Do the de Sitter extrema survive resolution of orbifold singularities and inclusion of the new moduli and fluxes carried by the resolved cycles?

sources.title: Rigid nongeometric orientifolds and the swampland

evidence.text: How are flux, axion, localized, and D-term contributions assembled before testing IIA de Sitter restrictions? Appendix B imports a generic two-derivative N=1 potential, rather than constructing a controlled vacuum in this window.

sources.title: Warped de Sitter compactifications

evidence.text: Under what metric and matter-field conditions do warped higher-dimensional solutions contain de Sitter spacetime, and can internal flux stabilize the compact-space scale in a lower-dimensional cosmological model?

sources.title: Systematics of Type IIA moduli stabilisation

evidence.text: Can a unified treatment of classical type IIA flux potentials systematically classify extrema, their supersymmetry and perturbative stability, and the restrictions on de Sitter solutions and AdS scale separation?

sources.title: Weakly Coupled de Sitter Vacua with Fluxes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can flux compactifications support de Sitter minima while a control parameter improves without bound? The paper separates this asymptotic question from the existence of individual vacua at finite large volume and weak coupling.

sources.title: On classical de Sitter solutions in higher dimensions

evidence.text: Which classical type-II orientifold compactifications to D>4 can satisfy necessary existence and perturbative-stability conditions for de Sitter vacua, as tested by the universal volume and dilaton directions?

sources.title: Complete classification of Minkowski vacua in generalised flux models

evidence.text: Which generalized-flux models in the isotropic type II orientifold class admit nonsupersymmetric Minkowski extrema with all retained moduli stabilized, and can stable extrema be continuously deformed to de Sitter?
